description:
The Apple Container backend runs Linux VMs via Virtualization.framework. The host macOS Nix store (/nix/store) is not available inside the VM. Without it, builds fail and the sandbox is non-functional for development.

Needed:
- Detect Nix installation type on host (Determinate Nix vs nix-darwin vs standard)
- Configure VM-level mount for /nix/store (read-only bind or volume)  
- Forward nix-daemon socket so sandbox uses host's nix daemon
- Validate nix store is accessible at container startup
- mounts.go has ToAppleArgs() but it's never called from apple.go

References: apple.go lines 18-22 (options documented), mounts.go lines 241-246 (darwin detection), DESIGN.md line 796
title: Apple runtime: Nix store integration in Virtualization.framework VM
